summary: Master the art of Strategic Account Management with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with tools to foster client loyalty and maximize revenue.
lede: Strategic account management is the structured process of selecting, developing, and retaining important client relationships. This training is for account managers, sales leaders, and customer success professionals responsible for account growth and retention; it covers segmenting accounts, mapping stakeholders, building joint plans, and tracking progress through business reviews and performance measures.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the health, growth, and retention of an organization's most significant revenue-generating assets.
audience: Client Relationship Managers in professional services
modules: Growth Strategy and White Space Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or customer success. A basic understanding of CRM systems (such as Salesforce® or Microsoft Dynamics) and financial literacy (understanding revenue, margin, and ROI) is required. No prior experience with specific SAM frameworks is necessary as these will be taught during the course.
